q2_gaps: stative locative predicate with a NON-containment preposition ("is located near X") — the instruction set routes "is located in / lies in / sits in / is situated in" onto LocatedIn only, and gives no form for near/beside/south-of position
approximator "just" on a spatial PP ("just south of Y") — "just" is covered only as the exclusive focus particle (Only), which is the wrong sense here, so the word is simply dropped
notes: Near and SouthOf are entity-attached preposition-named heads, licensed only by analogy with the one entity-attached example the instruction set gives, (From sk_wool_1 calderwick). (PartOf sk_foot_1 bay_street) follows the genitive part/whole test, though "the foot of a street" also brushes against the "a place inside a place is LocatedIn, never PartOf" rule.
